Description: Unique EPA RCRA identification number assigned by the implementing State or Region to each RCRA site.
Indicates the location (particular State, Territory, or EPA Region) of the agency that owns the GIS data.
System-generated value used to uniquely identify the feature.
The date the data was collected in yyyy-mm-dd format.
Optional name or identifier of the feature; may be used to store Regional Supplemental Control ID from Cleanup Site Geospatial Data Schema.
Code that categorizes the feature of a site the geometry represents [see nationally-defined values].
Code that represents the party responsible for collecting or otherwise providing geographic coordinates [see nationally-defined values].
Code that represents the measure of accuracy (in a range of meters) of the feature's coordinates [see nationally-defined values].
Code that represents the geometric entity described by the coordinates [see nationally-defined values].
Code that represents the place for which geographic coordinates were established [see nationally-defined values].
Code that represents the method used to determine the coordinates of the feature [see nationally-defined values].

Code that represents the reference datum used in determining the latitude and longitude coordinates for the site location. Note: This value must be '003' (World Geodetic System of 1984) and your geospatial data must use the WGS 84 coordinate reference frame for accurate representation in RCRAInfo and associated products.
Code that represents the method used to verify the coordinates [see nationally-defined values].
Indicates the location of the agency regulating the Corrective Action activity.
Indicates the agency that defined the Corrective Action event.
Code that corresponds to a specific Corrective Action event or event type. The first two characters indicate the event category and the last three characters the numeric event number.
System-generated value used to uniquely identify multiple occurences of a Corrective Action event.
Code indicating the agency responsible for overseeing a specific Corrective Action event.
Code indicating the agency responsible for conducting the evaluation (inspection).
The location (i.e. State) where the activity took place.
Name or number assigned by the implementing agency to identify an evaluation (inspection).
The first day of the evaluation, inspection, or record review regardless of the duration of the activity.
System-generated value used to uniquely identify a Corrective Action area.
System-generated value used to uniquely identify a process unit.
Optional comments with additional descriptive information about the feature (publicly releasable).
